=== SECTION: MG11 STATEMENT - ELLIE VARNA ===
I am Ellie Varna. I know Taylor Brookes through people in our estate. I gave a statement to police
 in April 2026 about
an incident outside Redwood House. On 09 May 2026 I received messages on WhatsApp from a contact s
aved in my
phone as T. I believed this was Taylor because of how he wrote and because I had spoken to him on 
that number
before.
The messages said I should 'stop talking' and 'remember who knows where you live'. I was frightene
d. I took
screenshots and sent them to PC Rowan Vale. I also played a voice note to my sister, but I could n
ot forward it
properly at the time.
I think the first message came in at around 22:45 on Friday 09 May 2026. I later told police in a 
follow-up call that it
was Saturday night after work. I am not completely sure because I was upset and the messages were 
on my phone
from the weekend. The screenshot shows 10 May at the top of one screen and 09 May on another scree
n.
I did not reply apart from sending a question mark. I blocked the contact after taking screenshots
. I did not keep a
screen recording. I have not changed my phone since then. The officer took photographs of my scree
n using his
device and asked me to email the screenshots, which I did.
Statement issues visible on face
- Witness says Friday 09 May in one paragraph and Saturday night in another.
- Witness belief of sender is based on saved contact name, writing style, and previous use of numb
er.
- Statement does not confirm original WhatsApp export or device extraction. NB-26-0721 - R v Taylor Brookes

=== SECTION: MG11 STATEMENT - ELLIE VARNA ===
I am Ellie Varna. I know Taylor Brookes through people in our estate. I gave a statement to police
 in April 2026 about
an incident outside Redwood House. On 09 May 2026 I received messages on WhatsApp from a contact s
aved in my
phone as T. I believed this was Taylor because of how he wrote and because I had spoken to him on 
that number
before.
The messages said I should 'stop talking' and 'remember who knows where you live'. I was frightene
d. I took
screenshots and sent them to PC Rowan Vale. I also played a voice note to my sister, but I could n
ot forward it
properly at the time.
I think the first message came in at around 22:45 on Friday 09 May 2026. I later told police in a 
follow-up call that it
was Saturday night after work. I am not completely sure because I was upset and the messages were 
on my phone
from the weekend. The screenshot shows 10 May at the top of one screen and 09 May on another scree
n.
I did not reply apart from sending a question mark. I blocked the contact after taking screenshots
. I did not keep a
screen recording. I have not changed my phone since then. The officer took photographs of my scree
n using his
device and asked me to email the screenshots, which I did.
Statement issues visible on face
Witness says Friday 09 May in one paragraph and Saturday night in another.
Witness belief of sender is based on saved contact name, writing style, and previous use of numb
er.
